note: SAMPLE DATA - fictional companies and text written for this demo.

leads.name: Ubuntu Dental (sample)
leads.text: Reception staff answer the same WhatsApp questions about bookings and prices all day, manually copy patient forms into the practice system and chase unpaid invoices by phone.

leads.name: Khumalo Freight (sample)
leads.text: Dispatchers retype delivery notes from PDFs and emails into a spreadsheet, quote by hand and lose time routing trucks. They already use a .NET ERP with an API.

leads.name: Marula Bakery (sample)
leads.text: Owner wants a nicer Instagram page and a printed menu. Orders come in person; no recurring admin pain mentioned.

leads.name: Sipho & Co Attorneys (sample)
leads.text: Paralegals summarise long contracts and search old matters by hand; client intake emails are sorted manually. Confidentiality is critical, so data must stay on their own server.

leads.name: Thandeka Property (sample)
leads.text: Agents answer the same listing questions, schedule viewings over WhatsApp and write listing descriptions from scratch for every property.
